M = Man, W = Woman

[00:04]OK … so three things about my childhood. `[00:09.8]Well, firstly, I used to … well, every summer, I used to go to the same place for my holidays. `[00:17]We used to go camping near a lovely beach in Wales.
[00:20.5]OK … Did you use to drive there?
[00:24.4]Yes … it took about three hours from where we lived.
[00:28]Mmm … next one?
[00:30.6]Next one … we used to have a dog …
[00:34]Right … when did you get it? I mean, how old were you?

[00:38.8]Well, I wanted a dog so much … I was really upset and I used to ask my mum all the time … And then my parents gave me a dog on my eleventh birthday! `[00:51]I couldn’t believe it. I was so pleased.
[00:54.2]OK … and … erm … the last one?
[00:58]And number three, … well, about school. `[01:02.9]I used to love playing out on the street with my friends.
[01:06.9]What did you use to play mostly?
[01:09.9]Ermm … We used to play football in the middle of the road … you know, there weren’t many cars, so it was OK.
[01:17.9]OK … so … so which one is false? `[01:23]Let’s see … Erm … about the dog … What was your dog’s name?
[01:29]Ermm … she was called Meg.
[01:31.9]Meg? What colour was she?
[01:34]Oh, sort of black and white.
[01:36.9]Did you use to take her out for walks?
[01:39.4]Yes, but mostly my dad took her out.
[01:42]Oh, but she was your dog …
[01:44.9]Err … yes, but …
[01:48]It’s not true, is it? You didn’t have a dog … that one’s false.
[01:53.2]Ermm … no I didn’t actually! You’re right. It’s false. `[01:58]I really wanted a dog – but we never got one! OK … your turn.
[02:03.8]OK ... first one …
